column1: # Gold-set reading variants: words real users type more than one way. Each
# listed reading emits its own gold row for the same sentence, so a walker
# that only wins from one of them shows up as a failure.
# 一/不/們 sandhi is detected mechanically and is deliberately NOT listed.
# Weight similarity is not used: tone is contrastive in Mandarin, so two
# readings scoring alike means the lexicon never separated them.
